name: Steal her
overview: After a one-night stand, Shen Que never forgot Song Wan Ning. He unexpectedly learned that Song Wan Ning wanted to please her husband, so he recommended himself and began to teach Song Wan Ning how to be a new woman. Song Wan Ning thought that Shen Que would teach her to please people in bed, but he began to teach her English, current situation, and politics word by word, and encouraged her to emancipate her mind and liberate herself. But on the other side, for Song Wan Ning, who had changed his face, Qi Zhou gradually changed his mind. The relationship between the three is in chaos.
